# Compliance Audit and Legal Risk Review

This document details the critical actions required following an audit, focusing on compliance and risk management.

## Key Actions:

*   Investigate legal risks identified based on audit findings.
*   Review internal controls based on audit recommendations.
*   Monitor ongoing legal risks as a result of the audit.
*   Monitor regulatory changes to ensure continuous compliance.
*   Investigate legal risks specifically related to the 2026 strategy.
